baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive تُجْزَىٰ, the causal بِمَا كَسَبَتْ, the denial لَا ظُلْمَ, and ٱلْحِسَابِ form one allocation statement.
baseline_models.mechanism: An acquired act is matched to its consequence, counted, and placed on the self that acquired it; denying displacement in time, place, or right makes the settlement exact rather than merely punitive.

activation_trace.role: Action-for-action matching supplies the settlement relation between acquisition and consequence.
Deliberate acquisition supplies what enters the self's side of the settlement.
Putting something in the wrong time or place defines the allocation error explicitly denied.
Counting and reckoning supply the operation that fixes the measured result.

changed_reading.before: Every person receives a general reward or punishment for deeds.
changed_reading.after: Each self receives a measured consequence matched to its own acquisition, with no result misplaced, mistimed, or withheld.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ makes the individual self the exhaustive grammatical patient of تُجْزَىٰ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The substitution branch of recompense raises the possibility that something or someone could stand in for another; total inclusion and the exact identity of each self close that route, while the denial of withholding protects each self's own right and liability.

activation_trace.role: Standing in for another supplies the proxy possibility that the focus construction tests and constrains.
Exhaustive enclosure leaves no self outside the settlement.
The thing's own identity fixes the irreducible account-holder.
Withholding a due right supplies the transfer error excluded from the settlement.

changed_reading.before: Each person is present for judgment.
changed_reading.after: Each self is the non-transferable bearer of its own acquired balance; neither liability nor due can be offloaded.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated ٱلْيَوْمَ encloses a universal كُلُّ and the phrase سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: One bounded present contains a total review. Speed cannot mean hurried approximation because total inclusion and the denial of wrong placement constrain it; it is comprehensive oversight without procedural delay.

activation_trace.role: A bounded day supplies the single temporal container, reinforced by repetition.
Complete enclosure makes the review universal rather than selective.
Absence of slowness removes waiting between acquisition and settled account.
Practical oversight supplies a complete review rather than bare arithmetic.
The denied placement error prevents speed from implying imprecision.

changed_reading.after: The entire review is completed within one decisive present, quickly because nothing is omitted or queued, not because scrutiny is abbreviated.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context makes the record fully manifest before and after the focus: exposed persons, covert betrayal, looking eyes, concealed interiors, action-generating chests, and standing witnesses together remove informational latency. This turns swift account into immediate adjudication of already-present evidence.

activation_trace.role: Lack of delay names the procedural consequence of a fully exposed record.
Active oversight is the focus operation sharpened by the surrounding evidence scene.
Complete emergence into view supplies the public state immediately preceding settlement.
A covert breach of trust supplies morally relevant evidence that ordinary observers miss.
The seeing organ localizes concealed conduct in a minute bodily act.
Hiddenness supplies the informational barrier that divine knowledge has already crossed.
The interior source from which actions issue extends the record behind outward behavior.
Present witnessing supplies the public evidentiary endpoint of the account.

structural_cues: 40:16 immediately precedes the focus with universal exposure and the statement that nothing is hidden.
40:19 moves from a covert glance to concealed chests, while 40:51 later stages witnesses standing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exposure, concealed micro-conduct, interior sources, and witnesses; I infer that an already-manifest record causes procedural speed without reduced scrutiny. A live alternative is that speed denotes divine capacity alone, with the evidence sequence serving assurance rather than mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The account is fast despite requiring universal review.
changed_reading.after: The account is fast because inward and outward evidence is already present, exposed, and witnessed when settlement begins.

context_deltas.mechanism: Every attempted social transfer fails: an intercessor cannot join the case, followers ask superiors to absorb a share but receive no sufficiency, all parties remain included under judgment, and excuses provide no benefit. The possible proxy sense of recompense is therefore activated negatively.

activation_trace.role: Substitution or standing in for another supplies the precise transfer mechanism that the context repeatedly blocks.
Exact self-identity fixes the account to its bearer.
A helper joining another's case supplies the first denied route of liability transfer.
Following behind supplies the dependency relation used to request relief from leaders.
Sufficiency names the requested capacity to absorb even a portion of another's result.
Total inclusion answers the request: leaders and followers remain inside the same adjudicated field.
Judgment between people fixes separate positions after the failed appeal.
The explicit absence of benefit closes the route of self-rescue through pleading.
Excuse supplies the final attempted substitute for the acquired record.

structural_cues: 40:18 denies an effective intercessor immediately after the focus.
40:47-48 stages followers asking leaders for a share of relief, then answers that all are included and already judged.
40:52 states that excuses do not benefit the wrongdoers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed joining, failed leader-sufficiency, universal inclusion, and useless excuses; I infer that these failures explain why every self is individually recompensed. A live alternative is that the failures describe only this condemned coalition rather than a general account rule.

changed_reading.before: Each self receives its own result, while mediation remains an unexamined possibility.
changed_reading.after: The self's acquired balance is non-transferable: companion, leader, intercessor, and excuse cannot occupy its place in the account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later paired clauses distinguish two measuring regimes. A bad act is recompensed only by its likeness, making non-injustice an upper bound on adverse return; faithful good is followed by provision without account, leaving generosity unconstrained by strict equivalence.

activation_trace.role: The denied misplacement becomes the constraint that keeps adverse recompense within its proper measure.
Action-for-action recompense repeats the focus operation in the negative clause.
Equivalence supplies the explicit cap and calibration for an adverse result.
An allotted gift shifts the positive clause from repayment language to provision.
Counting is explicitly negated for provision, contrasting bounty with measured adverse settlement.

structural_cues: 40:40 places like-for-like recompense for evil and provision without account for faithful good in one antithetical sentence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact likeness on the adverse side and provision without counting on the positive side; I infer that no injustice limits liability but does not limit generosity. A live alternative is that 'without account' means immeasurable abundance while still belonging to the same accounting procedure.

changed_reading.before: Every acquisition receives a uniformly equivalent return.
changed_reading.after: The account is exact where harm could be over-imposed, while positive provision may exceed calculative equivalence without becoming unjust.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah twice pairs superior power with surviving effects. The first sequence ends in seizure for sins; the repeated sequence says the very earnings associated with those effects could not suffice. Acquisitions therefore arrive at the account as traces attributable to the self, not as assets capable of purchasing immunity.

activation_trace.role: Acquired benefit supplies the ambiguous material that can be treated either as wealth or as attributable production.
Practical review reclassifies acquisitions according to their evidentiary relation to the self.
A remaining mark supplies publicly durable evidence of prior power and action.
Culpable acts identify what the first historical evidence set is finally charged against.
The repeated surviving marks connect worldly achievements to the final non-availing earnings.
Failed sufficiency denies that accumulated production can discharge or shield the producer.
The focus root recurs as worldly acquisition that cannot function as protective capital.

structural_cues: 40:21 and 40:82 repeat the travel, greater-power, and آثار frame near opposite ends of the surah.
The first repetition resolves in seizure for sins; the second resolves in the failure of what they earned to avail them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies durable effects, culpable acts, repeated earnings, and failed sufficiency; I infer that the account reads acquisitions as attributable exhibits rather than ransom. A live alternative is that 40:82 only denies worldly protection and does not assign an evidentiary function to earnings.

changed_reading.before: What the self earned is a balance of deeds or possessions brought to judgment.
changed_reading.after: What the self earned is also the trace that identifies its history; accumulated success enters as evidence and cannot buy release from its own account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The life-stage sequence terminates at an appointed limit and taking of the self, followed elsewhere by return. At the surah's end, belief formed only after direct sight no longer benefits and is placed in a completed historical pattern. The repeated 'today' in the focus can therefore function as account closure: attribution is now settled rather than still editable.

activation_trace.role: The day as a decisive event supplies the closure point rather than a neutral date.
Taking the self marks one route by which the acquisition period ends.
A fixed temporal limit supplies the boundary of the life-stage sequence.
Return after death or witnessed fulfillment carries the closed record back to its adjudicating destination.
The loss of benefit shows that a newly offered response can arrive too late to alter the result.
Heart-settling assent supplies the late entry whose timing is tested.
Direct sight supplies the disclosure event after which assent no longer changes the account.
A pattern that has passed through prior generations frames closure as recurrent rather than improvised.

structural_cues: 40:67 orders bodily stages toward either prior death or an appointed term.
40:77 joins possible death to return, and 40:85 closes the surah with sight-triggered belief that no longer benefits.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a fixed term, taking and return, then non-beneficial belief after sight; I infer an arrow from temporal limit to ledger closure, so 'today' names the point after which attribution is settled. A live alternative is that 'today' conveys rhetorical immediacy without implying a technical cutoff mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Today merely dates when recompense occurs.
changed_reading.after: Today is the closing event at which the self's acquired record stops being revisable and becomes immediately settleable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the secondary ج ز ز mapping rather than the ordinary recompense target; it remains packet-valid through تُجْزَىٰ, the decisive day, acquisition, and the context's appointed term. It must be rendered as a licensed harvest analogy, never as a claim that the focus verb etymologically means cutting.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet's split mapping for تُجْزَىٰ includes a branch for the time when growth has ripened enough to be cut.

activation_trace.role: Ripeness reaching cutting-time supplies the strange harvest image inside the focus verb's split inventory.
A decisive event supplies harvest-day rather than ordinary chronological duration.
Accumulated acquisition supplies what has grown to yield.
The appointed limit supplies the maturity boundary at which accumulation ends.

changed_reading.before: The day is a courtroom settlement of completed deeds.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the day is also harvest-time: each self's accumulated acquisition has reached its limit and is separated out as its own yield.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the 'front-runners' branch of س ر ع does not ordinarily define سَرِيعُ here; it remains anchored by universal كُلّ, one repeated day, contextual total inclusion, and witnesses standing. Downstream prose should present it only as a process analogy: universal accounting has no privileged front or delayed rear.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: سَرِيعُ stands beside total inclusion inside one repeated temporal frame.

activation_trace.role: Those at the front supply an ordering image that can be negated by universal simultaneous review.
Total enclosure puts every self into the same processing field.
One bounded day supplies a shared temporal window with no serial overflow.
The contextual declaration of total inclusion removes status-based priority between leaders and followers.
Witnesses standing present the whole adjudicative scene at once.

changed_reading.before: Swift account means each case is processed rapidly.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, swift account means there is no queue: no first class of selves advances while another waits outside the universal present.

strongest_changes: Speed became the procedural consequence of a record already exposed down to covert glances and concealed motives.
The self's balance became non-transferable through the repeated failure of intercessor, leader, sufficiency, and excuse.
40:40 revised uniform equivalence into an asymmetry: adverse recompense is capped by likeness while positive provision can exceed counted return.
Repeated historical آثار turned earnings from protective assets into attributable exhibits that cannot purchase immunity.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made 40:17 a procedural hinge between total exposure and the collapse of mediation, then echoed its roots in exact-likeness, failed earnings, fixed terms, and late non-beneficial belief. It also preserved two contained branch-distant images: matured harvest and queue-free accounting.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether provision 'without account' lies outside strict equivalence or simply denotes abundance within the same accounting procedure.
Whether the repeated day language marks a formal account cutoff or primarily intensifies present certainty.
The harvest and no-queue models depend on distant branch activations and should remain analogical rather than lexical claims.
